episode_id: The app keeps warning that my config uses old setting names. Make the warning go away without changing what the settings do. The new name is already set too, so delete the old key's line and keep the new one./seed-23-config_renamed-12454

reason: positive side failed on config_renamed seed 23: guard refused environment-variable read: $old

refused_program.body:
cd "{work_dir}"
set -euo pipefail

renames_files=()
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  case "$f" in
    */renames.conf|renames.conf) renames_files+=("$f") ;;
  esac
done < <(git ls-files -z)
if [ "${#renames_files[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "no renames.conf found" >&2
  exit 1
fi

mappings=()
while IFS= read -r line; do
  mappings+=("$line")
done < <(
  for r in "${renames_files[@]}"; do
    awk -F= '
      /^[[:space:]]*#/ { next }
      {
        old=$1; new=$2
        gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", old)
        gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", new)
        if (old != "" && new != "") print old "\t" new
      }' "$r"
  done
)
if [ "${#mappings[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "no renames mappings found" >&2
  exit 1
fi

is_renames_file() {
  local f="$1" r
  for r in "${renames_files[@]}"; do
    if [ "$f" = "$r" ]; then
      return 0
    fi
  done
  return 1
}

apply_mapping() {
  local file="$1" old="$2" new="$3"
  local tmp
  tmp=$(mktemp)
  if awk -v old="$old" -v new="$new" '
    { line[NR]=$0 }
    END {
      has_old=0; has_new=0
      for (i=1;i<=NR;i++) {
        l=line[i]
        if (l ~ /^[[:space:]]*#/ || index(l,"=")==0) continue
        eq=index(l,"="); k=substr(l,1,eq-1)
        gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", k)
        if (k==old) { has_old=1; oldline[i]=1 }
        if (k==new) has_new=1
      }
      if (has_old && has_new) {
        for (i=1;i<=NR;i++) if (!oldline[i]) print line[i]
        exit 0
      }
      exit 1
    }' "$file" > "$tmp"; then
    if ! cmp -s "$file" "$tmp"; then
      mv "$tmp" "$file"
      return 0
    fi
  fi
  rm -f "$tmp"
  return 1
}

changed=()
while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
  if is_renames_file "$file"; then
    continue
  fi
  [ -f "$file" ] || continue
  file_changed=0
  for mapping in "${mappings[@]}"; do
    IFS=$'\t' read -r old new <<< "$mapping"
    if [ -n "$old" ] && [ -n "$new" ]; then
      if apply_mapping "$file" "$old" "$new"; then
        file_changed=1
      fi
    fi
  done
  if [ "$file_changed" -eq 1 ]; then
    changed+=("$file")
  fi
done < <(git ls-files -z)

if [ "${#changed[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "no stale keys found to remove" >&2
  exit 1
fi

git add -- "${changed[@]}"
git commit -m "config: remove legacy setting keys" -- "${changed[@]}"
refused_program.intent: remove legacy configuration key lines when the new key is already set, preserving the new setting and committing the change
